 Follow “All’s Fair” Season 2 Release Schedule: When Do New Episodes of the Kim Kardashian-Led Legal Drama Come Out?
 The second installment of the Hulu series starring Kim Kardashian premiered on Nov. 4
 Kelly Allen Wed, November 4, 2026 at 2:00 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Kim Kardashian, Sarah Paulson and Naomi Watts in 'All's Fair' season 2
Credit: Ser Baffo/Disney NEED TO KNOW
 Hulu released the first three episodes of All's Fair season 2 on Nov. 4
 New episodes will be released on Wednesdays
 The legal drama stars Kim Kardashian, Naomi Watts, Niecy Nash-Betts, Teyana Taylor, Sarah Paulson and Glenn Close
 All's Fair is back with a vengeance.
 Season 2 of Hulu 's drama premiered on Nov. 4 with the release of the first three episodes. Following the debut, new episodes will drop weekly.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Centered on the scandals and secrets surrounding a team of female divorce attorneys, the series stars Kim Kardashian , Naomi Watts , Niecy Nash-Betts , Teyana Taylor , Sarah Paulson and Glenn Close .
 In season 2, the series will welcome a number of guest stars, including Dorinda Medley and Denise Richards , among others.
 Here's everything to know about the All's Fair season 2 release schedule.
 When does All's Fair season 2 premiere?
 Niecy Nash-Betts and Margo Martindale in 'All's Fair' season 2 
 Credit: Ser Baffo/Disney 
 All's Fair season 2 premiered on Hulu on Nov. 4.
 After season 1 premiered in November 2025, the debut became Hulu Originals' biggest scripted series premiere in three years after bringing in 3.2 million views globally after three days on the streamer, according to Deadline .
 Advertisement Advertisement This season welcomes a number of buzzy guest stars, including Richards as Jenna, Real Housewives of New York City alum Medley as Loni and Margo Martindale as Gloria.
 How many episodes are in All's Fair season 2?
 Season 2 of All's Fair will consist of eight episodes, according to Disney+. Previously, the show's first season totaled nine episodes.
 As season 1 dropped, the show was met with some negative reviews. However, the All's Fair cast maintained a sense of humor , with Kardashian sharing screenshots of several comments about the show's acting performances, costuming and storylines on Instagram .
 She captioned her post, "Have you tuned in to the most critically acclaimed show of the year!?!?!?"
 What is the All's Fair season 2 release schedule?
 Kim Kardashian and Glenn Close in 'All's Fair' season 2 
 Credit: Ser Baffo/Disney 
 The first three episodes of All's Fair season 2 dropped on Nov. 4.
 Advertisement Advertisement Episode 1 is titled "The Scorpio Ball," episode 2 is titled "Going Down" and episode 3 titled "Thanksgiving Part One." Following the premiere, Hulu will release new episodes every Wednesday, with the finale scheduled for Dec. 2, per Disney+.
 Here's the full All's Fair release schedule:
 Nov. 4: "The Scorpion Ball," "Going Down" and "Thanksgiving Part One"
 Nov. 11: "Thanksgiving Part Two"
 Nov. 18: "Liberty Unleashed"
 Nov. 25: "Queens" and "Frenemies"
 Dec. 2: "Carr Crash"
 What time do new episodes of All's Fair season 2 come out?
 Technically, All's Fair comes out on Tuesdays, if you're in Pacific Time. Episodes debut at 9 p.m. PT / 12 a.m. ET, per the show .
 How can I watch All's Fair ?
 Grant Show and Sarah Paulson in 'All's Fair' season 2 
 Credit: Ser Baffo/Disney 
 All's Fair season 2 is available to stream on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ .
 Advertisement Advertisement Season 1 of All's Fair is available to stream in its entirety on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.
